episode: E2A Tactical Breakdown: Shuffle Cut V1
lines: One screen. One cut. And the defender never sees it coming!
First, the ball swings to the wing.
He sets the back screen... right behind the defender.
The cutter waits for it. Slow... slow...
then he explodes off the screener's shoulder!
The defender gets caught chasing, right into the screen. The wing hits the cutter in stride... and there's your layup!
Screen. Cut. Finish. That's why timing matters more than just speed.
One screen. Perfect timing. Easy advantage.
